name: Daniel
overview: Daniel is a male descendant of Ithamar from the tribe of Levi, noted specifically as one who accompanied Ezra during the return from exile. He is recognized as an Aaronic priest and is mentioned on the sealed document in Nehemiah 10:6 and 10:8. His priestly lineage and role connect him to the religious restoration efforts of the post-exilic community.
namesAndTitles: The name Daniel means 'G-d is my judge,' reflecting a proper Hebrew name that emphasizes divine judgment and authority. This name is recorded in Ezra 8:2 and does not indicate a special title beyond its meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Daniel is explicitly identified as a descendant of Ithamar, linking him to a specific priestly lineage. Scripture does not record any additional family relationships beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Daniel's significance lies in his priestly heritage as a descendant of Ithamar and his participation in the post-exilic community's covenant renewal, as evidenced by his mention on the sealed document in Nehemiah. His role as an Aaronic priest highlights his involvement in the spiritual leadership during the restoration period. This positions him within the continuity of God's covenant people and their faithfulness amid returning from exile.
